groups.context: Two alternate exchanges reach the same conclusion about the tablet. Janus or Arcadius explains that local building materials make the stone unusual. Later Maria confronts the people raiding Sao Jorge. Their leader blames Europeans for the destruction of his village. Maria condemns the slave trade and plunder, challenges indiscriminate revenge, and asks him to help resist the great powers. His agreement and the tablet he found link that exchange back to the earlier discovery.
